text: Fire can be extinguished by water, the heat of the sun blocked by an umbrella, a cobra restrained by a sharp blade of kusha grass, an elephant in musth controlled by a goad, and stubborn cattle by a stick. Diseases can be cured by various medicinal combinations, and poison by the application of mantras. There is a remedy prescribed by the scriptures for every ailment, but there is no remedy for a fool.
